answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each identity burns a 60-credit fee to enter, and admission climbs a terrace of fees: the fee doubles at each step per operator, so later identities cost far more than the first. Only identities that complete real work reach the summit tier, where rewards are paid; idle or cloned names stay below and earn nothing. Trying to forge 1,000 identities costs at least 60,000 credits. One honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted rewards.
